card.name: Linking comma or 'and' in paired verb lists
card.fires_on: A comma or 'and' right after a verb in a list of paired actions, just before the next verb (prescribing, dispensing; sending and receiving). Also the hyphen-'de' in catecholamine-depleting.

modes.label: List separator after verb
modes.description: Comma or 'and' after the first verb of a list of linked actions, where another action verb comes next.
modes.example: when prescribing<<,>> dispensing, and administering Meperidine

modes.description: The word 'and' joining two contrasting activity words such as sending and receiving.

modes.label: Catecholamine-depleting
modes.description: The 'de' piece in the hyphenated drug class term before 'pleting'.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next item in a list, and away from common verbs like have, make, go.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or 'and' that sits between a series of actions, like prescribing, dispensing, administering.
